(set-logic QF_NIA)
(declare-const b Int)
(define-fun safe_batch () Int (ite (<= b 0) 1 b))
(define-fun amortized_ps () Int (div 9000 safe_batch))

; violation: safe_batch can be non-positive
(push)
(assert (<= safe_batch 0))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; violation: amortized_ps can be negative
(push)
(assert (< amortized_ps 0))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; violation: batch 64 does not amortize 9 ns to 140 ps by integer division
(push)
(assert (= b 64))
(assert (not (= amortized_ps 140)))
(check-sat)
(pop)

; violation: any positive batch at or below 64 yields less than the batch-64 floor
(push)
(assert (and (>= b 1) (<= b 64)))
(assert (< amortized_ps 140))
(check-sat)
(pop)
(get-model)
(get-info :all-statistics)
